On the Fourteenth Day of the Eighth Moon he accompanies Gaelor through the Watch barracks and Flea Bottom. He brings six gold cloaks into a mummers' tent at the prince's command. When Gaelor kills two actors and the audience stampedes, Saathos uses his shield and sword flat, refusing to use the edge. Eighteen smallfolk die in the ensuing crush and violence.

name: Steffon Baratheon
title: Lord of Storm's End
goals: Win the Crown's respect for House Baratheon
Secure a marriage worthy of his house
Prove himself beyond the tourney grounds
Win the tourney — which he did, by default, after neither prince could stand

relationships.alester-dayne: Faced him in the tourney semi-finals in one of the most brutal jousts in recent memory; won by throwing his own lance away and driving the butt end into Alester's stomach, then ran to his side the moment he fell. They embraced in the dirt to the crowd's approval.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Held in high esteem by the King for his house's past military service; Baelenys remains unaware of the insolence at the Hand's throne.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Demanded overdue debts from him before the whole court and was humiliated for his trouble; was unhorsed by him in the tourney quarter-finals and correctly assessed that Jace was holding back.
relationships.jaery-targaryen: He remembers the Queen as one of the people who made his humiliating audience with Jace worse, laughing that the Young Stag was still too young. Yet her later decision to send Maela to Storm's End proved she had not dismissed him or House Baratheon entirely.
relationships.maela-targaryen: Hosted her at Storm's End and fell for her completely, treating her with an awkward, earnest chivalry that charmed her even as she entertained his Kingsguard; offered to fetch her a dragon from Dragonstone without understanding why she laughed.

summary: Already famous in tourneys and duels despite his youth, Steffon Baratheon marched into the Red Keep demanding the Crown repay House Baratheon's old debts in blood and coin, only to be cut down before the court by Hand Jacaelon Targaryen. Weeks later he hosted Princess Maela at Storm's End, showing an earnest, almost childlike chivalry that charmed her without ever earning her heart. He won the King's Landing tourney by default when both princes collapsed in the lists — a hollow victory he was loudly furious about. His joust against Alester Dayne, however, was anything but hollow.

name: Timos Hightower
title: Former Lord of Oldtown
goals: Survive the Crown's judgment
Protect his sisters
Preserve what remained of House Hightower's honor

relationships.alysanne-hightower: His older sister, killed in the same massacre that claimed his life moments later.
relationships.brant-costayne: The knight who stood in oath to defend him, called for his revenge the moment he was killed, and died in the chaos that followed.
relationships.derrin-hightower: His father, whose secret treason condemned him before he understood what was happening.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Asked him for parley and mercy; drew his sword in panic when the answer became clear; was beheaded.
relationships.melessa-hightower: His younger sister; she survived the massacre in which he died.

summary: Thrust into Oldtown's lordship the moment his father vanished under suspicion, fifteen-year-old Timos Hightower tried desperately to comply with the Crown's demands. He asked Gaelor to enter with only a few men and speak. It was not enough. When the prince announced his execution, panic drove the boy to draw steel. He never had a chance to use it. His decapitated head rolled to a stop at Gaelor's boots. His death, and the massacre it triggered, will be remembered in the Reach for a hundred years.

name: Tion Lannister
title: Master of Coin
goals: Keep the Crown solvent
Temper the royal family's costlier impulses
Survive the King's temper long enough to matter
Prevent Highgarden's reparations from being immediately poured into a Stepstones war

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Regularly rebuked for prioritizing the treasury over the King's pride; was told to deal with the money and leave the rest to others.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: Works with him on the council's finances; their shared practicality occasionally makes them temporary allies.
relationships.ella-lannister: His mother, Lady of Casterly Rock.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Dismisses his war-hungry proposals as reckless, and is dismissed right back.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Finds an unlikely, if uneasy, ally in the Hand's more measured economic instincts; the two agreed publicly in council that beheading a sixteen-year-old does not mend the Crown's image.
relationships.tygett-lannister: His father, Lord of Casterly Rock and Warden of the West.
relationships.berholt-caswell: Promises the Crown will assist with the sept's delayed works, while explaining that the required sums cannot be found in a single afternoon.

summary: As Master of Coin, Tion Lannister spends most small council meetings being outvoted by princes eager for war and glory. He argued against pouring Highgarden's reparations straight into a campaign for the Stepstones, pointing out — correctly, and to no effect — that a war with no clear end is not an investment. He was the only voice at table to agree openly with Jace that executing a fifteen-year-old for his father's treason does not improve the Crown's reputation, a point the King ended by slamming his fist on the table. His counsel is sound and almost never followed.

name: Vahaemon Targaryen
title: Exiled Prince Vahaemon of House Targaryen

secret.note: Denied entry to Pentos by Targaryen diplomatic pressure. Has sailed for Tyrosh, where an informant within his camp reports he intends to offer the city the protection of his dragon in exchange for sanctuary and support.

goals: Regain some measure of standing for his name
Protect his daughters from afar
Survive the consequences of his own old betrayal
Avoid being funneled toward Tyrosh by Targaryen pressure

relationships.aenys-targaryen-ii: His father, King Aenys Targaryen II. Vahaemon grew up as the youngest of Aenys' three sons in a family already marked by rivalry and violence.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: His brother and King, who exiled him for treason during the seventh moon of his own reign — a cold war ended decisively, the realm was told, though the full details remain known only to those who lived through it.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: His uncle Baelor spent years studying Targaryen dreamers and the family's stranger histories at the Citadel. Some of that abandoned research later passed indirectly into Visenor's hands and now touches the struggle surrounding Vahaemon's name.
relationships.grance-morrigen: One of the knights who pulled him away from Maelwing while he screamed at Baelenys during the Cloudpass incident of 56 AC.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: His nephew has become one of the principal minds directing the Crown's effort against him. Vahaemon may not know how much of the pressure campaign bears Jace's hand, but the conflict has already reached Jace directly through Visenya and Dark Sister.
relationships.malaenar-targaryen: His steady brother, who stayed loyal to Baelenys throughout and whose very steadiness has always been the sharpest rebuke to Vahaemon's choices.
relationships.myles-mooton: One of the knights who pulled him back from Maelwing during the disastrous Cloudpass incident on his nameday in 56 AC.
relationships.naela-targaryen: His wife; her current whereabouts and condition are unknown.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: His daughter in exile; her secret letters to her siblings reignited the very suspicion that nearly destroyed her marriage, though the warning was never addressed to him.
relationships.vhaemys-targaryen-elder: His mother, the late Queen Vhaemys Targaryen.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: His nephew Visenor now treats Vahaemon's name as both a family danger and a political weapon. Without Vahaemon's knowledge, Visenor has considered forging evidence of an alliance between him and the Gardeners to redirect the Crown's fury.
relationships.visenya-targaryen: His other daughter, who is apparently neither in exile nor in Essos — but in King's Landing, walking freely through Flea Bottom with Dark Sister at her hip.

summary: Exiled from Westeros years before the events of the poisoning, Vahaemon Targaryen lives on beyond the Seven Kingdoms' reach, now believed to be in Pentos after the Crown engineered his expulsion from Braavos through economic pressure. He possesses a dragon of unknown origin — a fact that has consumed the small council's planning and Baelor Targaryen's strategy alike. His daughter Rhaella is hidden in Dorne, pregnant with a Targaryen heir. His daughter Visenya has materialized in a Flea Bottom brothel with Dark Sister and a blade at a prince's throat. Whether either development is his doing remains the most urgent unanswered question at the Hand's table. As a boy of twelve, on his nameday on the Twelfth Day of the Second Moon, 56 AC, Vahaemon led more than twenty men into Cloudpass in an attempt to approach Maelwing; the dragon burned his companions, Baelenys arrived to save him, and then claimed the beast himself.

name: Vhaemys Targaryen
title: Princess Vhaemys of House Targaryen

relationships.alester-dayne: Deeply attached to him and often followed him around the castle before his disappearance; she missed him openly and without shame the entire time he was gone.
relationships.annara-celtigar: Her closest friend at the Red Keep, a nine-year-old Celtigar girl who remains one of the few companions near Vhaemys's own age.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: After a nightmare convinces her Baelenys has died, she must see him alive before she can calm down. Baelenys comforts her and later calls her the family's most precious treasure.
relationships.daria-sand: The maid Jace quietly tasked with watching Vhaemys and making certain she attended her lessons after the chaos in the royal kitchens.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Her bond with Gaelor is intensely affectionate. He promises she will always be his most loved, no matter how many nieces and nephews follow, and she has defended him fiercely when the rest of the family called him a monster.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Runs to Jace after dreaming of Visenor shouting that someone has died amid fire. She trusts Jace with her repeating visions, including an immense white dragon she sees herself riding, and accepts his promise to listen to every dream.
relationships.jaery-targaryen: Her mother, beside whom she sheltered during the worst of the family's fracturing.
relationships.lorenah-dayne: Still jealous of the attention Jace gives Lorenah, but their hostility has begun to thaw. During Jace's proposal outing Vhaemys allowed Lorenah to kiss her cheek and happily accepted earrings that Lorenah fastened for her, though she remained jealous of Lorenah's necklace.
relationships.maela-targaryen: Her older sister and Jace's twin. Vhaemys looks to Maela as another familiar presence within the royal family even if their bond has not yet been tested by the same crises as her attachments to Jace, Saera, Gaelor, and Alester.
relationships.reyenald-reyne: Met the young swordsman after interrupting his practice with Lord Commander Orwell Morrigen; Reyenald immediately knelt and introduced himself.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Greets Saera's return from Winterfell with delight, immediately becoming fascinated by the white direwolf pup Saera carries and asking whether it is her present.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Her eldest brother among the King's children. His disappearance is one of the great absences in the family, though Vhaemys is too young to understand the politics that forced him away.
relationships.lucas-corbray: Her beloved Mustang carries her on his shoulders and indulges her, while secretly sparing servants from her punishments.

summary: Known since infancy as the Dragonet, Vhaemys begins to emerge as a possible Dreamer. She wakes screaming after seeing Visenor call out that someone has died amid fire, then tells Jace that she repeatedly dreams of riding a white dragon larger than Maelwing. Jace promises to hear every vision and Baelenys orders him to keep her close. She still covets Lorenah's horn-scale necklace, summons her friend Annara Celtigar to court, and is immediately enchanted by the white direwolf Saera brings home from Winterfell.

name: Visenor Targaryen
title: Crown Prince Visenor of House Targaryen

secret.note: At Highgarden under the identity of Maester Arthur Sand after traveling from Oldtown with Leo Tyrell, Clarisse Flowers and Martyn Mullendore. His identity remains concealed from the Crown. He does not know that Rhaella and their unborn child have died near Starfall. Boneskin's existence remains unknown to the Crown.

goals: Protect Rhaella and their unborn child
Maintain the identity of Maester Arthur Sand in Oldtown
Keep House Hightower and House Tyrell from collapsing into a Reach civil war
Prevent House Gardener from winning King Baelenys' support
Complete the forged letter linking Lord Gardener to Vahaemon and the supposed discovery of Vhagar
Build support without becoming dependent on House Tyrell
Return home a king worth trusting
Deepen his bond with Boneskin
Maintain secret contact with Rhaella

relationships.alester-dayne: The knight who saved his and Rhaella's lives twice over in the woods south of King's Landing, at tremendous personal cost. Visenor embraced him as a friend before he left Starfall.
relationships.almar-larchmont: Almar secures access to Baelor's old Citadel chambers and helps assess the Vhagar forgery. He insists that Renrose hear the plan before they proceed.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Once the King's most trusted child. That trust has now been shattered, along with two of his teeth.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: He has come to know Baelor partly through the old maester's research rather than through direct companionship. Letters and notes on dragons, dreamers, and Vahaemon reached Visenor in exile and quietly shaped the questions he began asking about his family. In the Citadel he uses Baelor's explicitly uncertain Vhagar research to make forged evidence credible to its intended reader, without proving that Vhagar has actually been found.
relationships.boneskin: A lean, pale-scaled dragon of extraordinary intelligence that had been roosting in the Red Mountains near Starfall. After days of patience, shared meals, and Valyrian songs, Visenor earned its trust and eventually rode it.
relationships.clarisse-flowers: A Hightower bastard and formidable swordswoman whom Melessa personally assigned as Visenor's protector. Visenor initially questioned the unexpected choice, only for Clarisse to decisively defeat him in their first private spar. He accepted the lesson readily and told her there was much he could learn from her.
relationships.edmyn-uller: The blunt Dornish maester who tended to him and Rhaella at the scholars' retreat and briefed him on events in the realm with startling frankness. Visenor found his honesty unexpectedly refreshing.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Often disagrees with his methods, though it was Gaelor who first argued Visenor should never split his clutch of dragons among the family.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: His opinion of Jace changed completely after learning of his secret help and the price Ser Alester nearly paid for it.
relationships.jaery-targaryen: His mother, who is desperate for news of him and has openly wept over his disappearance.
relationships.leo-tyrell: On the road from Highgarden, Visenor tries to reassure his uneasy pupil that Renrose is an honorable ally and future Hand. He does not know Leo overheard his parents' dangerous private conversation and has begun questioning the alliance.
relationships.lorenah-dayne: Granted him and Rhaella sanctuary despite the danger it posed to her own house. Visenor has promised to repay her hospitality when he is able.
relationships.maela-targaryen: His sister now carries Jadefyre, the one hatchling of his own clutch to survive.
relationships.martyn-mullendore: The Reach knight who recognised Visenor beneath his disguise during the Oldtown street ambush and chose to protect rather than expose him. Martyn brought him to Melessa Hightower, accompanied him to Highgarden, and remains among the small circle who know Arthur Sand is actually the Crown Prince.
relationships.melessa-hightower: The young Lady of Oldtown whose household now shelters him beneath the identity of Maester Arthur Sand. Visenor agreed to serve as her tutor in repayment of the debt his family owes House Hightower. Melessa is one of the few people in Oldtown trusted with his true identity.
relationships.renrose-tyrell: Lord of Highgarden and Visenor's most powerful political ally in the Reach. At the Mander's Pact, Renrose pledged the strength of House Tyrell to Visenor's claim in exchange for the Handship under his future reign and a marriage alliance between their children. Visenor accepted but remains wary of becoming dependent upon Tyrell power. At their latest breakfast he entrusts Renrose with the Gardener scheme and calls him his future Hand. He does not hear Renrose's later repudiation of loyalty to him.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: His wife and greatest love. At Highgarden he still speaks of protecting her and remains unaware that she and their unborn child die near Starfall on the fifteenth day of the eighth moon.
relationships.saera-targaryen: One of the siblings he trusts most.
relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: His exiled uncle and a threat to the Crown whose name Visenor is now prepared to weaponize. Visenor has proposed forging evidence of a secret Vahaemon-Gardener pact in order to turn Baelenys against Lord Gardener.
relationships.vhaemys-targaryen: His youngest sister, still a child when he vanished from King's Landing. He has always regarded her with the protective affection of an elder brother, though his exile has left them separated.
relationships.liana-tyrell: Renrose introduces Liana as his wife and confidante while she listens to their Highgarden conversation. Visenor does not witness her later warning to Renrose.
relationships.renrose-tyrell-daughter: Notices Renrose's daughter watching him at Highgarden and wonders whether she knows who he really is.

summary: Visenor leaves Highgarden wearing Elinor Tyrell's golden-rose brooch and treating Renrose as an honorable ally and future Hand. He tries to reassure Leo on the road, unaware that the boy overheard his parents and now doubts the plot around them. Visenor still misses his family and remains ignorant that Rhaella and their unborn child are dead. In King's Landing, Vhaemys dreams of him crying out that someone has died amid fire.

name: Weylar Rocke
title: Master of Whisperers to the Hand of the King
goals: Remain indispensable to Jace
Expand his network of informants throughout King's Landing
Never again see the inside of the black cells
Find a suitable tutor for Princess Vhaemys before the King's influence becomes permanent

relationships.daria-sand: Lorenah Dayne's maid and spy, who has been watching his increasingly conspicuous drunken behavior in Flea Bottom. Lorenah instructed Daria to speak with him and make him stop drawing attention.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: After drunkenly wasting his coin while searching inns for Visenya, Weylar receives a final warning. Jace sends him back into Flea Bottom to quietly learn what victims and families believe about Gaelor, the Watch and the Crown.

summary: Jace's personal spymaster, and proof that terror makes for sturdier loyalty than trust ever could. Weylar once fed the Prince a hollow report and spent time in the black cells for it; the pardon bought Jace an informant who now bows low enough to scrape the floor. His network has paid off repeatedly: first bringing word of Gaelor's brothel visit days after the wedding, then relaying early confirmation of the Oldtown Massacre. He has since been tasked with finding a tutor for young Vhaemys, a task he approaches with the same mixture of eagerness and dread that characterizes everything he does for the Hand.

name: Edmyn Uller
title: Maester of the Scholars' Retreat
goals: Tend to Rhaella at the scholars' retreat
Keep the hidden princess safe and informed
Recognize and decipher any covert message Visenor sends from beyond Dorne

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: He has never served Jace directly, but his blunt reports from the scholars' retreat proved useful to the Hand. Through ravens and the fugitives in Dorne, Edmyn has become an unlikely source of information for a prince he barely knows.
relationships.lorenah-dayne: Dispatched by Lady Dayne to the scholars' retreat to attend the fugitive prince and princess.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: Confirmed her pregnancy and attended her in hiding. He is missing by the fourteenth day of the eighth moon, when Rhaella repeatedly asks for news of him.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Previously tended to Visenor at the scholars' retreat. Visenor has now sent a coded raven toward Rhaella using a Dornish cipher specifically in the hope that Edmyn will be able to break it.
relationships.nymos: A younger maester attends Rhaella during Edmyn's unexplained absence. Their personal relationship and any direct exchange remain unshown.

summary: A Dornish maester dispatched by Lady Lorenah Dayne to attend Prince Visenor and Princess Rhaella at the scholars' retreat near Starfall. Unimpressed by titles and unusually direct in his delivery, he was the one who confirmed Rhaella's pregnancy and the one who briefed Visenor on the state of the realm — including the massacres, embargoes, and political collapses — with a vocabulary and frankness that made the Crown Prince laugh for the first time in weeks. His Dornish accent is heavy and his tongue is foul, which Visenor described privately as the most honest thing he had encountered since leaving King's Landing. By the fourteenth day of the eighth moon, he has been absent for days and Rhaella is increasingly alarmed. Nymos has no news of him. The unidentified body on the Dornish coast is not confirmed to be Edmyn.

name: Melessa Hightower
title: Lady of Oldtown
goals: Preserve House Hightower after the destruction of her family
Keep Visenor's identity hidden while he remains in Oldtown
Navigate the growing rivalry between the Tyrells and their challengers in the Reach
Keep Oldtown from becoming the battlefield of another great house

relationships.baelor-targaryen: Sent the Grand Maester a conciliatory invitation to return to the Citadel, though the unusually political wording made Baelor suspect that another authority had shaped the message.
relationships.almar-larchmont: The Hightower's maester and one of Melessa's most trusted protectors and advisers. Almar guards both her safety and her discretion, including correcting her whenever she comes dangerously close to exposing Visenor's identity.
relationships.alysanne-hightower: Her sister, killed in the same chaos that Melessa herself survived.
relationships.clarisse-flowers: A Hightower bastard whom Melessa values deeply and trusts enough to place personally at Visenor's side. She considers Clarisse the finest protection Oldtown can offer the hidden prince when he must leave the safety of the Hightower.
relationships.derrin-hightower: Her father, whose treason helped set in motion the catastrophe that destroyed much of their family.
relationships.leo-tyrell: The young heir to Highgarden, sent by Renrose Tyrell to Oldtown ostensibly to receive an education alongside her. His presence also places a Tyrell representative directly within her household.
relationships.martyn-mullendore: The knight who brought the disguised Visenor to her after recognising him during the Oldtown street ambush. His decision placed him inside the small circle protecting the prince's secret.
relationships.renrose-tyrell: The Lord of Highgarden whose influence now reaches directly into her household through his son Leo. The weakened Hightowers remain politically closer to the Tyrells than to their rivals, although the imbalance in power makes that friendship difficult to separate from dependence.
relationships.timos-hightower: Her brother, killed during the royal assault on Oldtown.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Shelters the missing Crown Prince inside the Hightower under the identity of Maester Arthur Sand. Visenor has entered her household publicly as a tutor, while Melessa is among the handful who know who he truly is. Their arrangement carries both personal and political weight, with Visenor regarding his service partly as repayment for what House Targaryen inflicted upon hers.

summary: Melessa Hightower survived the destruction that consumed much of her family and now occupies a position far larger than her years. With Derrin, Timos and Alysanne gone, the young Lady of Oldtown stands at the centre of a weakened House Hightower while the political order of the Reach shifts around her. Her household has also become the hiding place of the missing Crown Prince. Visenor Targaryen now lives beneath her roof as Maester Arthur Sand, publicly tutoring Melessa and Leo Tyrell while only a small inner circle knows his true identity. Melessa has placed considerable trust in Visenor, Maester Almar, Ser Martyn Mullendore and Clarisse Flowers, whom she personally assigned to protect the prince. At the same time, Renrose Tyrell's decision to place his heir inside the Hightower has drawn Highgarden closer to Oldtown than ever, leaving Melessa caught between protection, influence and dependence as rival powers begin testing House Tyrell's grip upon the Reach.

name: Visenya Targaryen
title: Princess Visenya of House Targaryen

secret.note: Was in King's Landing as of the seventeenth day of the seventh moon, 99 AC. Entered a Flea Bottom brothel, held Dark Sister to Prince Jacaelon's throat during a sexual encounter she initiated while believing him to be Gaelor. Fled before Alester Dayne could catch her. Current location unknown.

goals: Determine who she will need to kill when the family's war in Essos begins
Demonstrate to the Red Keep that Vahaemon has friends inside its walls
Retrieve or protect Dark Sister
Return to wherever she came from without being caught

relationships.alester-dayne: She escaped him after he smashed into Jace's chamber and tried to seize her. Visenya slipped Alester's grip, flashed a concealed dagger close enough to cut his tunic, and vanished into King's Landing before the Kingsguard could recover.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: She is remembered by Baelor from childhood, though what she thinks of her scholarly great-uncle now is unknown. His attempt to understand her motives places him among the few people at court treating her as more than a blade-shaped threat.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Mistook him for Gaelor in a Flea Bottom brothel; held Dark Sister to his throat throughout the encounter and left before he or Alester could detain her. Their conversation suggested she is watching the Essos campaign closely.
relationships.naela-targaryen: Her mother, Princess Naela Targaryen, whose current location and condition remain unknown.
relationships.rhaella-targaryen: Her sister, whose current location and condition she presumably does not know.
relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: Her father; whether she acts under his orders or entirely on her own initiative is the question Jace and Baelor cannot yet answer.

summary: Daughter of the exiled Vahaemon Targaryen, Visenya materialized in King's Landing on the eve of the grand tourney with a blindfold over her eyes, a jagged scar across her cheek, Dark Sister in a canvas bag, and a working knowledge of where Gaelor Targaryen drinks. She entered a Flea Bottom brothel, climbed into Jacaelon's bed believing him to be his brother, held her ancestral blade to his throat for the duration, and walked out before Alester Dayne could catch her. Her message was the point: the Red Keep has vulnerabilities it does not know about, and Vahaemon Targaryen has either placed them there or has someone clever enough to find them on her own. She is currently unaccounted for. The cut on Jace's neck has healed. The questions have not.

name: Naela Targaryen
title: Princess Naela of House Targaryen

secret.note: No information about Naela's current whereabouts or condition is known to the realm.

goals: Unknown

relationships.rhaella-targaryen: Her daughter, currently in hiding in Dorne.
relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: Her husband; she is believed to remain in exile alongside him, though her present condition and exact whereabouts are uncertain.
relationships.visenya-targaryen: Her daughter, whose current location even Rhaella does not know.

summary: Naela Targaryen, wife of the exiled Vahaemon. Her current whereabouts, health, and disposition are unknown.

name: Godfrey Blackwood
title: Lord Godfrey Blackwood of Raventree Hall
traits: Openly Unconventional in His Personal Tastes
goals: Build goodwill with the new Hand of the King
Perform creditably in the tourney lists
Enjoy himself without apology
Secure Crown justice for his cousin's death at Bracken hands

relationships.clarisse-flowers: He once crossed swords with Clarisse while she was disguised as a man in a tournament. If her account is to be believed, she left the famed Blackwood warrior with injuries that took him a long time to forget.
relationships.clover-tully: He no longer trusts Clover to arbitrate the feud with House Bracken. After Clover dismissed his cousin's killing as a drunken mistake and refused to mobilize against Stone Hedge, Godfrey bypassed his liege and appealed directly to the Crown.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Tackled Ser Brant Costayne into the mud when Costayne drove a sword through Gaelor's horse's chest and attempted to murder the prince — an intervention that likely saved Gaelor's life and has not yet been formally acknowledged.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Complimented his tenure as Hand before the tourney and faced him in the quarter-finals in a hard six-pass tilt; was unhorsed cleanly and congratulated Jace from the dirt. Alester reported seeing him descend from an inn's upper rooms flanked by a serving wench and a stableboy, and noted that he makes no secret of his tastes. Brought the Bracken border killing before the Hand's throne; was offered two paths — a Crown envoy or a trial by combat — and accepted both as grounds to wait. Also threatened to ride North to Stark if the Crown failed him, a gambit Jace noted without flinching.
relationships.perric-bracken: He holds Perric responsible for the border killing of his cousin, rejecting the Bracken claim that it was merely a drunken accident. The dispute has become personal enough that Godfrey bypassed Lord Tully and carried his demand for justice to the Crown.

summary: A well-traveled lord from the Riverlands who arrived at the tourney with kind words for the Hand and a six-pass joust that lasted long enough to impress the stands before Jace's final lance throw sent him into the dirt. He congratulated Jace graciously, which cost him nothing; he then saved Gaelor Targaryen's life by tackling Brant Costayne mid-assassination, which cost him rather more. He makes no secret of his broader appetites, a fact Ser Alester noted with mild amusement from a roadside inn and relayed to Jace with more detail than was strictly necessary.

name: Renrose Tyrell
title: Lord of Highgarden and Warden of the South
goals: Secure the position of Hand of the King under Visenor's future reign
Cement the Tyrell-Targaryen alliance through a marriage between their children
Maintain eyes on Visenor's movements through Leo's presence in Oldtown
Seize House Gardener's lands as soon as the Crown brands its lord a traitor
Raise House Tyrell above every rival, including Visenor Targaryen

relationships.almar-larchmont: He regards Almar as part of the machinery keeping Oldtown stable and Melessa protected. Almar, however, watches Renrose's influence over the weakened Hightowers carefully and is wary of how easily assistance can become control.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: He considers Gaelor the principal obstacle between Visenor and the throne and has privately argued that the prince must be removed for the sake of the realm and Oldtown's dead. Renrose's hostility is political, strategic, and increasingly tied to succession.
relationships.leo-tyrell: Dispatched his fourteen-year-old son to Oldtown under the guise of education alongside Melessa Hightower — in practice, a political foothold and a pair of eyes inside the Hightower.
relationships.martyn-mullendore: Relies on Mullendore as a trusted sword arm operating in Visenor's orbit; Martyn's loyalty to the prince rather than to Renrose directly is a variable he has not yet been forced to reckon with.
relationships.melessa-hightower: Sees her as a piece to be positioned rather than a person; inserting Leo into her household is partly about influence over the last Hightower heir.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: He welcomes Visenor's plan to frame Lord Gardener and agrees to seize the rival house's lands. Although Visenor likes and trusts him, Renrose privately resolves that House Tyrell's ambition must ultimately rise above the prince as well.
relationships.liana-tyrell: His wife and closest confidante. He welcomes her knowledge of his dealings with Visenor, but rejects her warning against pursuing still greater power.
relationships.renrose-tyrell-daughter: His unnamed daughter, present beside him at the breakfast welcoming Visenor to Highgarden.

summary: Lord Renrose Tyrell receives Visenor at Highgarden and embraces the plan to frame House Gardener as Vahaemon's secret ally. His role is to invade and secure Gardener lands the moment the Crown declares their lord a traitor. Yet after Visenor places the scheme in his hands, Lady Liana warns Renrose not to mistake the prince's trust for permission to demand more. Renrose rejects her restraint and privately resolves that the only worthy course is one that places House Tyrell above every other family—including Visenor's.

name: Ser Martyn Mullendore
title: Knight of the Reach
goals: Protect Visenor and ensure his survival in the Reach
Navigate the competing interests of Renrose Tyrell and the prince without openly defying either

relationships.leo-tyrell: Rode alongside Leo on the journey from Highgarden to Oldtown; their dynamic is that of an experienced knight tolerating a haughty fourteen-year-old.
relationships.melessa-hightower: Delivered Visenor to her in the hall where her brother was killed; their relationship is defined by that single fraught moment.
relationships.renrose-tyrell: Operates within Renrose's orbit but his demonstrated loyalty runs toward Visenor personally rather than to the Lord of Highgarden — a distinction that has not yet been tested openly.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Recognised the disguised prince during the Oldtown street ambush and brought him to Melessa Hightower; has since ridden with him to Highgarden and now to Oldtown as part of his cover, making him one of the four people who know Visenor's true identity inside the Hightower.

summary: Ser Martyn Mullendore is a knight of the Reach who stumbled into Visenor's orbit by chance and chose loyalty over convenience. He led the City Watch patrol that intervened in the Oldtown alley ambush, recognised the disguised prince, and delivered him to Lady Melessa rather than to the authorities — a decision that has since drawn him fully into the conspiracy. He now rides as part of Visenor's cover retinue in Oldtown, one of only four people inside the Hightower who know Maester Arthur Sand is a prince of the blood. In Chapter XVII, the party reaches Highgarden after several days on the road during which Visenor drills Leo in swordplay, footwork and endurance, with Clarisse and Martyn often joining the lessons.

name: Berholt Caswell
title: High Septon
goals: Deliver verdicts and guidance that he can honestly believe the gods would sanction
Preserve the Faith's independence without provoking a confrontation he cannot win
Act justly within the limits of what he believes is survivable — and wrestle privately with where that line sits

relationships.baelor-targaryen: A tense, unequal antagonism. Baelor pushed hard; Berholt held his ground with a serenity that infuriated the Grand Maester, but he was also aware he was holding ground on a verdict rather than on the larger question — Gaelor's unpunished sin — where he had already failed to act. After the massacre he raises the sept works Baelor repeatedly deferred and obtains a promise of assistance from Tion.
relationships.brant-costayne: Saw in him a man who did what Berholt himself had not: acted on his convictions regardless of cost. That recognition, more than theology, drove him toward mercy.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Never formally sanctioned him for Alysanne Hightower's murder — not from fear alone, but from a genuine uncertainty about whether an excommunication would serve the gods or simply detonate a crisis he could not contain. He is not sure he made the right call, and that uncertainty coloured everything he said at the trial.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Agrees to lead rites and help calm Flea Bottom after Jace condemns Gaelor and Tion promises help for the sept's works. Their agreement serves both the grieving city and the Faith's standing.
relationships.tion-lannister: Accepts Tion's promise of financial assistance and gives the Crown time to provide it.

summary: High Septon Berholt Caswell is a man of genuine faith and genuine limits. After the Mummers' Blood, he answers Jace's request for the Faith to calm Flea Bottom by raising the sept works that Baelor had delayed. Berholt stops short of an ultimatum or Gaelor's excommunication; the Crown promises financial help, and he agrees to conduct rites for the dead and stand before the grieving city on the Crown's behalf.

name: Leo Tyrell
title: Heir to Highgarden
goals: Prove himself useful to his father's alliance with Visenor
Receive the education his father sent him to Oldtown for
Develop his skill with a sword
Earn the respect of Visenor and the older men around him

relationships.almar-larchmont: The Hightower maester who oversees much of the household surrounding Leo and Melessa. Almar is particularly strict about ensuring Leo remembers that Visenor must always be treated as Maester Arthur Sand whenever the disguise matters.
relationships.martyn-mullendore: Rode from Highgarden to Oldtown in his company. Martyn treats him with the patience of an experienced knight accustomed to the pride of a young lord.
relationships.melessa-hightower: Sent to Oldtown to receive an education alongside the young Lady of Oldtown. Their proximity also strengthens the political connection between Highgarden and the weakened House Hightower.
relationships.renrose-tyrell: Overhears Renrose and Liana discussing the danger surrounding their secret ambitions. The discovery leaves him withdrawn and uncertain even as Visenor praises his father as an honorable future Hand.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Still admires his princely tutor, but begins asking what Visenor will do to his family if he takes the throne. Leo's affection is now complicated by the dangerous conversation he overheard at Highgarden.
relationships.renrose-tyrell-daughter: His unnamed sister is present at Highgarden when the traveling party returns. Her response to Leo's training has not been shown.
relationships.clarisse-flowers: Joins swordplay and endurance lessons with Clarisse during the journey to Highgarden.

summary: Leo Tyrell is the fourteen-year-old heir to Highgarden, proud of his name and already conscious that his father expects more from him than lessons and good manners. Renrose sent him to Oldtown ostensibly to be educated alongside Melessa Hightower, but Leo also serves as a quiet Tyrell presence inside the Hightower and among the small group protecting Visenor Targaryen's secret identity. The prince now tutors him publicly as Maester Arthur Sand. Their relationship has already begun moving beyond politics: during private sword practice Leo displayed surprising agility and promise, even catching Visenor cleanly across the head with a wooden blade. He remains haughty and eager to impress, but beneath the pride is a boy beginning to understand the responsibilities that will one day accompany Highgarden. In Chapter XVII, the party reaches Highgarden after several days on the road during which Visenor drills Leo in swordplay, footwork and endurance, with Clarisse and Martyn often joining the lessons.

name: Almar Larchmont
title: Maester of the Hightower
goals: Protect Melessa Hightower and preserve her position in Oldtown
Maintain Visenor's cover identity within the Hightower
Prevent a Reach civil war from destroying what remains of House Hightower
Help Visenor contain the Gardener threat without exposing Oldtown
Find a way to use Citadel contacts without alerting Grand Maester Baelor

relationships.leo-tyrell: One of the two young nobles placed under Arthur Sand's instruction at the Hightower. Almar keeps Leo mindful of the prince's disguise and has little patience for the boy forgetting that, when others may hear, Visenor is Maester Sand.
relationships.melessa-hightower: His primary charge and deepest loyalty. Almar acts as healer, adviser and quiet guardian to the young Lady of Oldtown, protecting her from political dangers as readily as physical ones.
relationships.renrose-tyrell: Regards the Lord of Highgarden as an important but potentially overbearing ally. Renrose's decision to place Leo within the Hightower gives House Tyrell influence close to Melessa, something Almar watches carefully.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Helps Visenor obtain access to Baelor's papers with Melessa's sealed permission. He believes the resulting deception may work but is uneasy about exploiting Baelor's private studies and requires Renrose's involvement.

summary: Maester Almar serves the Hightower as healer, adviser, and one of the principal guardians of Melessa Hightower and Visenor's hidden identity. The Gardener-Tyrell crisis has pulled him directly into Visenor's political calculations. Almar warned that the Gardeners now possess greater economic momentum than the Tyrells, are distributing grain to hungry parts of the Reach, and may seek King Baelenys' backing. Visenor's answer is a proposed deception: a forged Tyroshi letter implying an alliance between Lord Gardener and Vahaemon, leaked through the Citadel. Almar has contacts capable of helping, but understands that any false evidence must also survive the scrutiny of Grand Maester Baelor. His overriding priority remains keeping Melessa, Oldtown, and the hidden prince alive through whatever comes next. In Chapter XVII he arranges Visenor's Citadel access, hears the proposed Vhagar letter and insists that Renrose approve the plan before further action.

name: Ser Baran Strong
title: Sworn Sword of Dragonstone
traits: Loyal to Those Who Treat Him Fairly
goals: Return to the Red Keep and to meaningful service
Prove his worth to Prince Gaelor

relationships.alester-dayne: Met him at Dragonstone; needled him about the Kingsguard preferring pretty faces, and received a mild, unimpressed reply. Alester noted the size and filed it away.
relationships.curtass-whent: Brawled with him inside the Red Keep; both were stripped of their white cloaks, though Baran was deemed the party in the right and exiled to Dragonstone rather than disgraced. He despised Whent and makes no pretense otherwise.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Offered a place in Gaelor's service at Dragonstone; Gaelor extended the invitation after hearing his grievance and assessing his size and bearing.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Acknowledged him as Lord Hand and was told plainly there is a place for him in the Red Keep — but that Gaelor does not get to make that decision unilaterally.
relationships.malaenar-targaryen: Has served as his sworn sword on Dragonstone since the exile; Malaenar regards him as one of the finest knights in the Seven Kingdoms and is openly reluctant to give him back.
relationships.saathos-maris: He drank with Saathos and Alester on Dragonstone and found in Saathos the same blunt professional language common among hard-used knights. Saathos helped draw Gaelor's attention toward Baran, while Baran immediately began probing the stories around Curtass Whent's death.

summary: A near-seven-foot wall of muscle and grievance, Baran Strong was once a Kingsguard whose career ended in a brawl with Curtass Whent inside the Red Keep itself. Stripped of his white cloak but judged the wronged party, he was exiled to Dragonstone rather than disgraced outright — a distinction he appreciates and resents in equal measure. Prince Malaenar calls him one of the finest knights in the Seven Kingdoms. Prince Gaelor, after a single evening's conversation at the stables, decided to find out if that was true.

name: Tansy Riverside
title: Paramour of the Lord of Dragonstone
goals: Secure her position beside Malaenar
Be acknowledged by the royal family, however reluctantly

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: She endured Baelenys calling her his brother's 'wench' before the entire hall and held the King's gaze without flinching.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Caught his eye more than once during the evening; he extracted himself before anything could happen, aware of exactly what was at stake.
relationships.malaenar-targaryen: Her companion of two years. She organized the nameday feast that summoned the royal family to Dragonstone without telling him first, a move the family received with barely concealed contempt.

summary: A seventeen-year-old of no house and considerable ambition, Tansy has spent two years at Dragonstone as Malaenar Targaryen's companion. She organized his nameday feast and invited the royal family without asking him first — a gambit that put her at a high table with a king who called her a wench and a crown prince who looked at her the way men do when they are deciding not to. She showed no sign of finding either development discouraging.

name: Perric Bracken
title: Lord of Stone Hedge
goals: Press House Bracken's advantage over the Blackwoods wherever possible
Avoid Crown intervention

relationships.bethany-bracken: His niece, whose marriage to Oscar Tully recently tied House Bracken to the ruling Tully line.
relationships.clover-tully: He remains Clover's bannerman and benefits politically from the marriage tying his niece Bethany to Clover's grandson Oscar. That same family bond has become one reason the Blackwoods doubt Clover can judge the feud impartially.
relationships.godfrey-blackwood: Ancient rivals; his men killed Godfrey's cousin near the border under circumstances he characterized as an accident and Godfrey characterized as murder. The Hand has offered him a trial by combat if he refuses to negotiate.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Has not yet responded to the Crown's envoy or the trial-by-combat challenge.

summary: Lord Perric Bracken of Stone Hedge, whose men killed a Blackwood cousin near the border in circumstances that remain disputed. He called it an unfortunate accident during an altercation; Lord Godfrey Blackwood called it a deliberate provocation and brought the matter to the Hand of the King. Perric's niece Bethany is newly married to Oscar Tully, grandson of Lord Clover Tully, further complicating the Riverlands dispute.

name: Clover Tully
title: Lord of Riverrun, Lord Paramount of the Trident
goals: Keep the Riverlands at peace
Avoid taking sides between Blackwood and Bracken

relationships.bethany-bracken: He is connected to Bethany through her marriage to his grandson Oscar. The match binds House Bracken to Clover's own bloodline and has become politically significant amid the worsening Blackwood-Bracken dispute.
relationships.elwood-tully: His son and heir, the father of Oscar Tully.
relationships.godfrey-blackwood: His bannerman; refused to grant him vengeance or marshal forces against the Brackens, calling the border killing a drunken mistake. Godfrey bypassed him entirely and went to the Crown.
relationships.oscar-tully: He is Oscar's grandfather and Lord Paramount, with the younger Tully standing in the line that will carry Riverrun forward. Oscar's marriage into House Bracken has also tied Clover's family directly to one side of the current river feud.
relationships.perric-bracken: His bannerman and Lord of Stone Hedge; their houses are now tied by the marriage of Clover's grandson Oscar Tully to Perric's niece Bethany Bracken, a connection Godfrey Blackwood sees as compromising Clover's neutrality.

summary: Lord Clover Tully of Riverrun, Lord Paramount of the Trident. Notoriously passive and recently bound to House Bracken by the marriage of his grandson Oscar Tully to Lord Perric Bracken's niece Bethany, he refused to give Godfrey Blackwood the justice he demanded for his cousin's death — calling it a drunken mistake and urging peace. Godfrey took the matter to the Hand of the King instead.

name: Aenys Targaryen II
title: Former King of the Seven Kingdoms

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: His son and eventual successor.
relationships.edwyle-stark: The Lord of Winterfell was an important ally who aided Aenys in ways that remained significant to House Targaryen long after both men's deaths. The exact nature of Edwyle's service has not yet been revealed.

summary: The late King Aenys Targaryen II, father of Malaenar, Baelenys, and Vahaemon. His reign and treatment of his family left wounds that still shape the royal house. Among the great lords who supported him was Edwyle Stark of Winterfell, whose service to Aenys remained important enough that Baelenys still remembered the debt decades later.

name: Vhaemys Targaryen
title: Former Queen of the Seven Kingdoms

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Her son.

summary: The late Queen Vhaemys Targaryen, wife of Aenys II and mother of Malaenar, Baelenys, and Vahaemon. She is distinct from King Baelenys's young daughter Princess Vhaemys.

name: Alysa Targaryen
title: Former Lady of Dragonstone
summary: Malaenar Targaryen's first wife, a Targaryen by blood. She died before Tansy Riverside came to share Malaenar's life on Dragonstone.

name: Vaenarr Targaryen
title: Prince Vaenarr of House Targaryen

relationships.jaery-targaryen: His sister, Queen of the Seven Kingdoms.

summary: A Targaryen prince and sibling of Queen Jaery.

name: Tygett Lannister
title: Lord of Casterly Rock, Shield of Lannisport and Warden of the West

relationships.tion-lannister: His son, who serves the Crown as Master of Coin.

summary: Lord Tygett Lannister, Lord of Casterly Rock and Warden of the West. He is the father of Tion Lannister, the Crown's Master of Coin.

name: Ella Lannister
title: Lady of Casterly Rock

relationships.tion-lannister: Her son, the Master of Coin.
relationships.tygett-lannister: Her husband, Lord of Casterly Rock.

summary: Lady Ella Lannister, wife of Tygett Lannister and mother of Tion Lannister.

name: Myrielle Marbrand
title: Lady Myrielle Marbrand of Ashemark

relationships.tion-lannister: Her husband, the Crown's Master of Coin.

summary: The wife of Tion Lannister, Master of Coin.

summary: Harrik 'Drowned Servant' Greyjoy, a gigantic Ironborn warrior remembered as one of Baelenys Targaryen's most famous opponents in the Iron Islands. Harrik died in 77 AC at the age of forty-four, when Baelenys was thirty-six.

name: Maron Dayne
title: Ser Maron Dayne of Starfall

relationships.alester-dayne: His only son. Maron's death while Alester was still a boy left a wound that continued to shape his son's loyalties and sense of duty.
relationships.lyarra-karstark: His Karstark wife. Their marriage began as a purely political match, though Alester's recollections suggest that it eventually became something more genuine.

summary: Ser Maron Dayne was the father of Ser Alester Dayne and husband of Lyarra Karstark. His marriage to the Northern lady began as a political arrangement, though their son would later imply that affection grew between them. Maron was killed by Dornishmen early in 91 AC at the age of thirty-two. The exact circumstances of his death remain unresolved. Alester was still a boy when his father died, and the survival of Maron's son became inseparably tied in Alester's memory to King Baelenys.

name: Lyarra Karstark
title: Lady Lyarra Karstark of Karhold

relationships.alester-dayne: Her only son. She survived Maron by nearly two years, leaving Alester orphaned before he had reached manhood.
relationships.maron-dayne: Her late husband. Their marriage began as a political match between a Dornish house and a Northern one, though Alester's account suggests it eventually grew into genuine affection.

summary: Lyarra Karstark was a highborn woman of the North, wife of Ser Maron Dayne and mother of Ser Alester Dayne. Her marriage to Maron began as a political arrangement, though Alester's recollections imply that the relationship eventually became more than duty. After Maron's death early in 91 AC, Lyarra survived him for nearly two years. She died toward the end of 92 AC at the age of thirty-five, leaving the young Alester without either parent.

name: Elwood Tully
title: Heir to Riverrun

relationships.clover-tully: His father, Lord Paramount of the Trident.

name: Oscar Tully
title: Knight of House Tully

relationships.bethany-bracken: His wife, whose marriage to him recently tied Houses Tully and Bracken.

summary: Grandson of Lord Clover Tully and son of Elwood Tully. His recent marriage to Bethany Bracken has become politically important amid the Blackwood-Bracken dispute.

name: Bethany Bracken

name: Clarisse Flowers
title: Sworn Sword of Oldtown
goals: Protect Visenor Targaryen while he remains in Oldtown
Serve Melessa Hightower faithfully
Prove her worth through skill rather than birth or sex
Earn the recognition denied to her as both a bastard and a woman

relationships.godfrey-blackwood: Once faced him while disguised as a man in a tournament. Clarisse claims she left the renowned warrior with wounds that took a long time to heal.
relationships.melessa-hightower: A woman Clarisse holds in great loyalty and esteem. Melessa considers her one of the most valuable people in her service and personally assigned her to protect the man publicly known as Maester Arthur Sand.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Assigned by Melessa Hightower as Visenor's personal protection during his concealed stay in Oldtown. Their first private spar ended with Clarisse overpowering him, pinning his wooden sword beneath her boot and placing her own blade at his throat. Visenor was impressed rather than offended and openly admitted that he had much to learn from her.
relationships.leo-tyrell: Helps train Leo alongside Visenor and Martyn on the road to Highgarden.

summary: Clarisse Flowers is a twenty-year-old bastard of Hightower blood, a short-haired, physically imposing swordswoman who was raised more like a son than a daughter and never prepared for the conventional life of a lady. Though neither a knight nor, by her own insistence, a lady, she has developed into an exceptional fighter and claims to have crossed swords with some of the realm's greatest knights while competing in disguise as a man. Among them was Lord Godfrey Blackwood, whom she says she left badly wounded. Lady Melessa Hightower values Clarisse highly and, on the Ninth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC, assigned her to protect Visenor Targaryen throughout his concealed stay in Oldtown as Maester Arthur Sand. Visenor initially admitted surprise at being given a woman as his protector, prompting Clarisse to explain that she had never been raised as a conventional woman and could outfight many of the knights he had known at the Red Keep. When Visenor asked to test that claim, Clarisse proved it. After a hard spar that bloodied the prince's nose, she trapped him against a tree, evaded his counterattack, pinned his wooden sword beneath her boot and placed her own blade against his throat. Visenor accepted the defeat with good humor and told her there was clearly much he could learn from her. In Chapter XVII, the party reaches Highgarden after several days on the road during which Visenor drills Leo in swordplay, footwork and endurance, with Clarisse and Martyn often joining the lessons.

name: Benjen Stark
title: Lord Benjen Stark of Winterfell
goals: Serve House Stark and his elder brother faithfully
Represent Winterfell well in Rickard's absence
Hone his skill as an archer and hunter

relationships.alester-dayne: Welcomed him formally to Winterfell and reminded him that, through his Karstark mother, the North was part of his own blood as well.
relationships.brandon-stark: His late father. Benjen was only fifteen when Brandon died in 99 AC.
relationships.edwyle-stark: His paternal grandfather, who ruled Winterfell and served as Warden of the North before the titles passed first to Brandon and later to Rickard.
relationships.rickard-stark: His elder brother and Lord of Winterfell. Benjen serves him loyally and received Saera and Alester on Rickard's behalf when they arrived at Winterfell.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Received her warmly when she returned to Winterfell; Saera greeted him with an immediate embrace before asking after Rickard.

summary: Benjen Stark is the fifteen-year-old younger brother of Lord Rickard Stark. Fine-boned and long-legged, with a cold, piercing gaze, he is already a skilled archer and rugged hunter and is rarely seen without a fine recurve bow. When Princess Saera returned to Winterfell with Ser Alester Dayne on the Thirteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC, Benjen led the Northern party that received them while Rickard was away preparing a gift for the princess. Though young, he carried himself with formal courtesy and treated Alester not merely as a royal knight, but as a man returning to the lands of his mother.

name: Mother Marya
title: Servant of Winterfell
goals: Tend the rare plants of Winterfell
Offer guidance in her own cryptic manner

relationships.alester-dayne: Encountered him in the snow on his first visit to Winterfell. She used a rare glass-like flower to deliver a cryptic warning about beauty, thorns, and the burden of care, then welcomed him 'home' despite his confusion.
relationships.rickard-stark: Assisted in the private moment when Rickard presented Saera with a white direwolf pup, using her herbs to let the princess see the gift with her own eyes.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Used the steam of an herbal drink to clear Saera's clouded vision for a few miraculous seconds, allowing the princess to see Rickard and the white direwolf pup he had brought her.

summary: An elderly, blind servant of Winterfell known to most as Old Nan, though she introduces herself as Mother Marya. She tends a small patch of rare flowers and possesses knowledge that does not sit comfortably within ordinary household service. When Ser Alester Dayne encountered her during his first visit to the North, Marya showed intimate knowledge of a fragile, metallic-petaled flower that grows only rarely in Winterfell and beyond the Wall, using it to offer him a cryptic warning about beauty and thorns. The following night she stood beside Rickard Stark and Princess Saera with a steaming herbal drink; when Marya blew its vapor into Saera's face, the princess's clouded eyes cleared for several seconds and she saw perfectly for the first time in years. Whatever Marya truly knows, neither Alester nor Saera yet understands it.

name: Edwyle Stark
title: Former Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North

relationships.aenys-targaryen-ii: A significant ally of King Aenys Targaryen II. Edwyle aided him in ways that remained important to House Targaryen decades later, though the exact nature of that service has never been specified.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: He rendered important service to King Aenys, a debt that outlived him. Baelenys remembered that service decades later and allowed it to shape the Crown's treatment of Edwyle's descendants.
relationships.benjen-stark: His younger grandson through Brandon Stark.
relationships.brandon-stark: His son and successor as Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North. Though Baelenys had little personal affection for Brandon, Edwyle's past service to Aenys continued to shape the Crown's treatment of his descendants.
relationships.rickard-stark: His elder grandson through Brandon Stark, who eventually inherited Winterfell and the wardenship after Brandon's death.

summary: Edwyle Stark was Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North, father of Brandon Stark and grandfather of Rickard and Benjen Stark. Born in 28 AC, he belonged to the same broad political generation as King Aenys Targaryen II and became a significant ally of the Crown during Aenys' reign. Edwyle aided the King in ways that Baelenys still considered important many years later, though the precise nature of those services remains unknown. He died in 87 AC at the age of fifty-nine, after which Winterfell and the wardenship passed to his son Brandon. More than a decade after Edwyle's death, Baelenys openly admitted that although he had never cared much for Brandon personally, what Edwyle had done for Aenys still mattered enough for the Crown to honor the Stark family upon Brandon's death.

name: Nymor Martell

relationships.naella-velaryon: Her daughter, now married to Prince Gaelor Targaryen and carrying his child.

summary: Lady Alyssa Velaryon is a thirty-two-year-old noblewoman of House Velaryon and the mother of Princess Naella Velaryon.

name: Annara Celtigar
title: Lady Annara Celtigar of Claw Isle

relationships.vhaemys-targaryen: Her closest friend at the Red Keep. Annara, a Celtigar girl of the same general age, remains at court and is one of Vhaemys's most constant companions.

summary: Annara Celtigar is a nine-year-old girl of House Celtigar who resides at the Red Keep and is Princess Vhaemys Targaryen's closest friend there.

name: Daria Sand
title: Maid to Lady Lorenah Dayne
goals: Serve Lorenah Dayne faithfully
Gather useful intelligence within the Red Keep
Keep watch on threats developing around Jacaelon and Lorenah

relationships.cordin-poole: Identified his growing alliance with Gaelor and reported it to Lorenah.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Learned that Gaelor and Cordin Poole had entered an alliance against Jace and that Gaelor was moving to take command of the City Watch.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Received a quiet instruction from Jace to watch Vhaemys and ensure that the princess attended her lessons.
relationships.lorenah-dayne: Her lady, employer, and the person to whom she reports the intelligence she gathers among servants and throughout King's Landing. Lorenah trusts her enough to discuss sensitive matters openly.
relationships.naella-velaryon: Learned through another maid that Naella had been urging Gaelor to move more aggressively against Jace. Daria jokingly offered to 'handle' the princess, an offer Lorenah declined.
relationships.vhaemys-targaryen: Was assigned by Jace to keep watch on the young princess and make certain she truly attended her lessons.
relationships.weylar-rocke: Has observed Jace's spymaster drinking heavily, running up bills in Flea Bottom in the prince's name, and getting himself beaten. Lorenah instructed Daria to speak with him and make him stop drawing attention.

summary: Daria Sand is a twenty-three-year-old Dornish maid who came to King's Landing in Lorenah Dayne's household and serves as far more than a domestic attendant. She acts as Lorenah's eyes and ears among the servants and in the lower reaches of the city. Early in the sixteenth chapter, Daria reported Weylar Rocke's increasingly conspicuous drunken behavior in Flea Bottom, the emerging alliance between Prince Gaelor and Maester Cordin, and Naella Velaryon's efforts to push Gaelor into action against Jace. Lorenah treated the intelligence seriously but without panic and ordered Daria to deal with Weylar's public foolishness. Jacaelon later asks her to watch Vhaemys and ensure that she attends her lessons.

name: Ser Myles Mooton
title: Former Sworn Brother of the Kingsguard

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Rode in Prince Baelenys's roughly thirty-man party to Cloudpass on the Twelfth Day of the Second Moon, 56 AC, when the prince went to retrieve his younger brother Vahaemon.
relationships.derrin-hightower: Rode with Derrin Hightower during the Cloudpass incident of 56 AC.
relationships.grance-morrigen: Fellow knight in Baelenys's Cloudpass party; together they approached Vahaemon and drew him back from Maelwing.
relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: Alongside Ser Grance Morrigen, helped pull the terrified young prince away after Maelwing emerged from the clouds.

summary: Ser Myles Mooton was a thirty-five-year-old Riverlands knight on the Twelfth Day of the Second Moon, 56 AC. He rode with Prince Baelenys, Derrin Hightower, Ser Grance Morrigen and roughly thirty men toward Cloudpass after Vahaemon's reckless attempt to approach Maelwing ended with more than twenty men burned to ash. When the dragon emerged, Myles and Grance advanced despite their fear and pulled Vahaemon back while Baelenys remained before the beast and ultimately claimed Maelwing.

name: Ser Grance Morrigen
title: Former Sworn Brother of the Kingsguard

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Rode close behind the young prince during the Cloudpass crisis of 56 AC and followed him toward Maelwing despite openly dreading what the party had ridden into.
relationships.derrin-hightower: Rode with the young Derrin Hightower during the Cloudpass incident; Derrin urged him to keep pace as the party hurried after Baelenys.
relationships.myles-mooton: Fellow knight in the Cloudpass party, with whom he approached Vahaemon and pulled the boy away from the dragon.
relationships.orwell-morrigen: His brother, Ser Orwell Morrigen, who later became Lord Commander of the Kingsguard.
relationships.vahaemon-targaryen: Alongside Ser Myles Mooton, took hold of the terrified young prince and pulled him away as Baelenys faced Maelwing.

summary: Ser Grance Morrigen was thirty-four years old on the Twelfth Day of the Second Moon, 56 AC, when he rode in Prince Baelenys's party to Cloudpass. He was openly uneasy about the situation and muttered about what they had gotten themselves into as the party climbed into the clouds. After finding Vahaemon surrounded by the burned remains of his men and seeing Maelwing emerge, Grance nevertheless advanced with Ser Myles Mooton and helped drag the frightened young prince to safety while Baelenys stood his ground before the dragon.

name: Drack Harlaw
title: Lord of the Iron Islands
summary: Drack Harlaw is the seventy-five-year-old Lord of Harlaw, an Ironborn noble of House Harlaw. Surviving portraits also preserve his appearance at forty-one, decades before the present day.

name: Zekar Alasyr
title: Mummer of the Motley Three
goals: Keep the Motley Three at the height of their craft
Use comedy to puncture the pretensions of the powerful
Remain loyal to the Flea Bottom stages where the troupe began

relationships.merryn-whitespring: His longtime fellow performer and equal in the Motley Three; together they trained Mydan before the apprentice grew into their peer.
relationships.mydan-gerren: Once his pupil in acting, improvisation and reading a crowd; now an equal partner, though traces of the old mentor's instinct remain.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Satirized the royal family as part of the troupe's farce before Gaelor killed him during the massacre on the Fourteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC.

summary: Zekar Alasyr was one of the two senior hands of the Motley Three, a celebrated troupe whose fame reached far beyond Flea Bottom. Natural charisma, an ever-mocking expression and a dangerous comic edge let him seize an audience with a glance. Alongside Merryn Whitespring he trained the younger Mydan Gerren in acting, improvisation, vocal and physical mimicry, crowd work and the judgment needed to test the limits of satire. By the troupe's final performance Mydan stood beside them as an equal. Their returns to Flea Bottom were acts of loyalty to the neighborhood and stages that made them, not signs of obscurity. That reputation made Gaelor's attack upon their royal farce a cultural and political outrage as well as a massacre.

name: Mydan Gerren
title: Mummer of the Motley Three
goals: Master every kind of role
Preserve the Motley Three's hard-won standing
Honor the Flea Bottom audiences that first embraced the troupe

relationships.zekar-alasyr: His former mentor in improvisation, mimicry and commanding a crowd, later his professional equal in the Motley Three.
relationships.merryn-whitespring: His former mentor in stagecraft and comic timing, later his professional equal in the Motley Three.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Faced the real prince during the troupe's royal satire, survived the massacre and was taken prisoner by Gaelor's soldiers.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Receives Jace in the black cells and gives him a firsthand account of the massacre. He refuses to become a Crown mouthpiece, but listens when Jace promises protection, restitution and help rebuilding the Motley Three's stage.

summary: The last surviving member of the Motley Three remains imprisoned after Gaelor killed Zekar Alasyr and Merryn Whitespring and the trapped audience stampeded. Jace visits him in the black cells, hears his testimony and promises that the Crown will help repair the troupe's property and protect any future performance. Mydan does not know whether he can ever act again, but Jace urges him not to let the site of his masters' deaths become the final meaning of their stage.

name: Merryn Whitespring
title: Mummer of the Motley Three
goals: Perfect the Motley Three's fearless satire
Keep returning to the stages that gave the troupe its start
Make even the realm's most powerful figures answerable to laughter

relationships.zekar-alasyr: His longtime fellow performer and equal in the Motley Three; together they shaped the troupe and trained Mydan.
relationships.mydan-gerren: Once his student in stagecraft, transformation and comic timing; now an equal partner despite the small habits left by their old roles.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Helped perform the royal satire that Gaelor interrupted, and was killed during the massacre on the Fourteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC.

summary: Merryn Whitespring was a relaxed, cunning and flamboyant master of the stage, one of the older two members of the Motley Three. He and Zekar Alasyr raised Mydan Gerren from pupil to peer, teaching him the full craft of performance and the perilous art of judging an audience. The three became renowned across the realm for crude farce, razor-edged satire and merciless impersonations of nobles and royals. They still returned to small Flea Bottom stages out of allegiance to the place where they began, despite possessing fame, technical mastery and social influence far beyond the district. Merryn was killed during Gaelor's assault on the Fourteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC; the attack therefore struck at a recognized cultural institution, not an anonymous band of street fools.

name: Ser Lucas Corbray
title: Knight of the Kingsguard

relationships.vhaemys-targaryen: His beloved charge, whom he indulges and protects; she helped give him the nickname Mustang.
relationships.orwell-morrigen: His Lord Commander, who welcomes him back from the Vale.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Cooperates with Jace to spare the kitchen maids and gently manage Vhaemys.

summary: Known as the Mustang, Lucas Corbray stands second only to the Lord Commander among the Kingsguard. Bald, scarred and immensely strong, he returns to the Red Keep after nearly a moon and a half in the Vale. He adores Vhaemys, who reminds him of his dead younger sister, and quietly sends servants away for the day when the princess demands their punishment.

name: Reyenald Reyne
title: Young swordsman training at the Red Keep

relationships.orwell-morrigen: His sword instructor, who warns him against overconfidence.
relationships.vhaemys-targaryen: Meets the princess after she interrupts his practice.

summary: A thirteen-year-old boy with striking crimson hair, Reyenald trains with wooden swords under Lord Commander Orwell Morrigen. Orwell praises his skill but warns that his arrogance could kill him. Their practice ends when Princess Vhaemys interrupts.

name: Ser Oswald Eagle
title: Commander of the City Watch

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: The King had promised his command to Gaelor, but cancels that appointment after the Flea Bottom massacre.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Gaelor's promised command collapses after the massacre. Oswald, who was not present, removes the implicated men and remains to bear the institutional consequences.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: The Grand Maester anticipates his resentment at losing command.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Jace assures him that Gaelor bears responsibility for the massacre, asks him to remain commander and urges restraint toward angry citizens.
relationships.orwell-morrigen: Morrigen assures him that the council has not summoned him to pronounce guilt and listens to his decision to remain in service.

summary: A seasoned commander in his late forties, Oswald remains in charge of the City Watch after Gaelor's promised appointment collapses with the Flea Bottom massacre. Before dawn he removes every gold cloak directly involved from duty and surrenders them for judgment. Though he considers resigning under the weight of the Watch's disgrace, he decides that abandoning the city would dishonor his years of service and accepts Jace's request to stay.

name: Nymos
title: Maester at Starfall

relationships.rhaella-targaryen: Attends the hidden princess, knows of her pregnancy and answers her questions discreetly before her maid. Agrees to prepare provisions for her charitable village walk.
relationships.edmyn-uller: The missing older maester whose absence he cannot explain to Rhaella. No account of what happened to Edmyn is confirmed.
relationships.darren-dayne: Reports that Lord Dayne left Starfall for Sunspear four days before his conversation with Rhaella. No secret orders from Darren are established.

summary: A younger maester attending Rhaella at Starfall while Edmyn Uller is missing. Nymos knows of her pregnancy and understands the need for discretion before her maid. On the fourteenth day of the eighth moon he reports no news of Edmyn, says Lorenah remains safe in the Red Keep, and explains that Lord Dayne left for Sunspear four days earlier. He agrees to arrange food for Rhaella's village walk, then checks the corridor before closing the door. His caution does not establish complicity in the later attack.

name: Liana Tyrell
title: Lady of Highgarden

relationships.renrose-tyrell: Her husband, who calls her his closest confidante. She warns that his appetite for power risks wasting Visenor's trust and endangering their family; he rejects her restraint.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Recognizes that Visenor likes and trusts Renrose. She urges her husband to preserve that advantage rather than exploit it without limit.

summary: Lady Liana is Renrose Tyrell's wife and closest confidante. She listens as Visenor and Renrose discuss their alliance at Highgarden. That evening she warns her husband that the prince's affection and trust can benefit their family if Renrose accepts their limits. She sees his appetite for greater power as a danger, but her warning does not dissuade him from placing House Tyrell above every other family. Her birth house and age have not been established.

name: Elinor Tyrell
title: Daughter of the Lord of Highgarden

relationships.renrose-tyrell: Her father, beside whom she stands when Visenor arrives at Highgarden.
relationships.leo-tyrell: Her brother, Renrose's heir, who returns to Highgarden with Visenor's party. No private exchange between the siblings is shown.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Presents Visenor with a golden-rose brooch before his departure from Highgarden. Visenor fastens it to his clothing at once, visibly delighting her.

summary: Elinor Tyrell is Lord Renrose's daughter and Leo's sister. After watching the visitor known as Maester Arthur Sand with fascination at Highgarden, she addresses him openly as her prince before his departure and presents him with a finely worked golden-rose brooch, which he immediately wears. Her exact age, knowledge and intentions remain unconfirmed.
